s10.old: **Flows into the model via LIVE formulas** (edit only Committee Data, then recalc): `Committee Data`!B -> `Rank & Allocation`!E (`=IFERROR(INDEX('Committee Data'!$B$2:$B$320,MATCH(name,...)),0)`) -> `Blended Model`!E -> col L Committee% / col Q Influence pillar -> col R Influence% -> Score. So recomputing B auto-propagates to Score / Rank. To change chair / ranking weight or a committee's tier: edit the multipliers / the `Seats held` tier text, recompute B / C / D with the scorer, write back, recalc (under the no-COM regime the recalc happens when the user opens Excel, `fullCalcOnLoad`, and the pillar snapshot refreshes). Validator + scorer: session scratchpad `cmte_validate.py` (2026-06-30). See `moneyball-model-config`.
s10.why: "See `moneyball-model-config`" names a memory file

CORRECTION to an earlier claim: the orphans are NOT uniformly non-pytest (of 118 suites: 75 unittest, 25 self-running, **11 pytest**, 5 bare-tests-no-runner). Facts for the remaining ~63 orphans: `run_tests.py` now reads FOUR native verdict shapes (`N passed, M failed`; unittest `Ran N tests` + OK/FAILED; reflective `PASS <name>` lines; `N BILLSTATUS ... tests passed`) from stdout AND stderr; unrecognised verdict = FAILURE by design; **`fec` has NO `__init__.py`** (PEP 420 namespace package; suites using `from fec import ...` only work with the repo root on `sys.path`, 9 suites held on this); **settle vacuity by TRACING, never by AST** (3 fully vacuous + 1 at 6%: `article_cross_reference` defines 74 assertions and runs ZERO); snapshot method (git tag is NOT sufficient since `*.json` / `*.csv` are gitignored: add a manifest of sha256 < 8MB, size + mtime above, over repo root + fec + tests + BOTH `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Melange\*\derived` roots, plus a physical copy of repo-root files < 2MB, ~48MB); all 59 ran with **0 mutations**, re-verified byte-identical twice. This lane is NOT in the chain: 57 of 59 cover non-chain producers (runs manually); coupling is indirect but real, since its artifacts are read by `audit_full.py`, which IS a chain step.

s10.old: - **The `:966` dedup defect is FIXED.** `fec/audit/build_system_manifest.py:966` appended `newest_file` with no membership test against `top`; because `pick_sentinels` truncates `by_size` to `SENTINEL_COUNT` at `:1073` *before* the `seen` dedup at `:1090`, a file that was both largest and newest ate a slot and evicted the true third-largest. The fix adds `and newest_file[0] not in {t[0] for t in top}` (rows are `(rel, size, mtime)`). Blast radius was **3 stores, not the 2 the brain listed**: `mdata.bicam_zips` 2 -> 3, `mdata.bicam_extracted` 2 -> 3, `repo.data_district` 2 -> 3. **`mdata.residual` was NOT affected** (it has 4 rows; that entry in the old note is stale). The worktree copy of the producer still carries the defect. See [[sentinel-collectors]] for the sentinel-workbook side.
